goal.claim: Win: place blob (magenta center) on center of hollow 12px ring of same color. L1 ring purple matched purple blob.

arm_mechanics.claim: One global white diamond=draggable end. Click far cell->white end teleports there; blob=FLOOR(centroid of that arm's endpoints). Click in 5x5 box of an endpoint->that endpoint becomes white. Click near white=no-op.

goal.claim: Put each colored blob (magenta center) on center of same-color hollow 12px ring. L2 purple ring (18,57), orange ring (51,40).
